messages:
leo: Heads-up - FinPlat is ready to start a 2-week POC. They will not allow cross-account VPC peering. Asking for a minimal connectivity handoff for Private deployments.
jana: OK - plan A = AWS Interface Endpoint (PrivateLink) + our endpoint service. They want to control endpoint creation on their side.
pranav: We'll need their AWS account ID, VPC CIDR, subnets for ENIs, and security contact. Also confirm whether they want us to advertise NTP/DNS or use their resolvers.
leo: They want client IPs preserved in app logs. Is that feasible with PrivateLink?
pranav: Short answer: yes but with constraints. PrivateLink terminates at our ENI; to keep original src IPs you need either a passthrough proxy or ensure we don't SNAT on the egress path. For hosted we typically SNAT; for dedicated/private deployments we can configure SNAT off if their security team accepts route flows.
jana: Note for their netops: create interface endpoints in each AZ used by their subnets. Attach security groups allowing inbound from their subnets on 443. No routes required in their route tables beyond default.
ops_bot: checklist: 1) AWS account ID 2) VPC CIDR 3) list of subnet IDs per AZ 4) contact for firewall change 5) expected pps/rps 6) whether TLS inspection is in path
leo: Firewall snippet for their ops team (drop-in):
```
# Allow to Redwood interface endpoint ENI IPs (replace with endpoint ENI private IPs)
Allow tcp 443 from 10.20.0.0/16 to <endpoint-eni-cidr>
Allow tcp 443 from 10.20.1.0/24 to <endpoint-eni-cidr>
# NTP/DNS if required
Allow udp 123 from 10.20.0.0/16 to 169.254.169.123 (if using metadata proxy)
Deny all other outbound to external ranges except approved management IPs
```
pranav: MTU note: If they run IPSec to their edge and theres encapsulation, suggest lowering MTU to 1400 on the app hosts to avoid fragmentation.
jana: Security questions flagged by their infosec: key ownership (they want CMK), audit log retention 12+ months, proof of SOC2, and vulnerability scan cadence.
leo: We can support customer-managed KMS for Private. For hosted, we provide audit exports (CloudTrail) and SOC2 report. "Proof of vulnerability scans" -> we can provide pen test summary and scan schedule.
legal: Legal flags: they want a clause for an on-prem install option within 90 days if regulatory blocking arises. Thats an enterprise-only ask; need legal + eng input before committing.
pranav: Pricing for POC: recommend hosted burst for 2-week trial unless they need sustained throughput. Estimate here is ~ $1.5k-3k depending on token mix and caching. If they want guaranteed 100 RPS sustained we should propose a short dedicated reservation and offer credit.
jana: Operationally: we will publish our service name (com.redwood.private.finplat) and provide the service endpoint details for them to create interface endpoints. They will need to accept the VPC Endpoint connection on their side if we require acceptance.
leo: Meeting: arranging netops handoff Tue 9am PT. Ive invited FinPlat netops, their security lead, and our eng oncall.
ops_bot: Action items assigned: leo -> get AWS account ID + CIDR; jana -> create service name + endpoint docs; prAnav -> draft firewall + MTU notes; legal -> review on-prem option.
pranav: small correction: my handle is pranav (lowercase), will post route table example before the handoff.
leo: thanks all. We'll push the security pack (SOC2 link, CMK steps, audit export guide) ahead of the call. :thumbsup:
